title: Reproduce and improve context-transfer time decoding in mouse medial entorhinal cortex
goal: Recreate the original findings and separately exceed them on the same source-paper task: Predict elapsed time within the 20-second tDNMS trial from MEC spiking, training each decoder on LS, SL or SS trials and testing all three contexts. The Figure 6f biological gap is distinct from the underlying prediction error.
primary_outputs: Reproduction: executable submitted analysis and source-native outputs for the complete original finding and companion panel.
Improvement: candidate outputs and a comparison on the same original task under improvement.v1.json.
Separate evidence for both outcomes under matched paper+data and paper+data+author-code conditions.
success_criteria: Assess reproduction and improvement independently under reproduction.v1.json and improvement.v1.json; do not combine their scores.
Preserve the original task, full panel, permitted observations, metrics, aggregation and required companion controls.
Reproduction requires a source-grounded computation and independently verified granular outputs; copying published findings alone is insufficient.
Improvement requires the unchanged improvement contract's same-task comparison, uncertainty and admission rules.
Use outcomes.v1.json for the matched information conditions and budgets; a declared contract or admitted receipt is not scientific qualification.
Author-baseline replay remains calibration. Historical reconstruction attempts retain their original scope and are not promoted to new qualified AI reproduction results.

data_contract.animal_mapping: All13 source-list session IDs must join an authenticated author-defined eight-mouse mapping. The source strings and multiplicities are admission constraints, not permission to infer animals by filename prefix.
data_contract.input: All selected per-session spikes.h5 cluster keys and complete source trial/trial_type/result/trial_time columns, paired with authoritative behavior and unit rosters; original files and excluded rows remain in private lineage.
data_contract.private_target_boundary: Owner keeps true time bins, trial/context/outcome/mouse/source-path lineage and complete expected-row universe. Protected actors receive only permitted calibration and opaque-ID neural queries; no scientific answer cache, reference outputs or owner algorithm in paper-only inputs.
data_contract.rows_and_folds: Forty time bins per eligible trial per source-context decoder; all source trial/time/cell rows remain grouped for ten authenticated source-order folds. Private expected rows and hashes are computed by the owner before actor output. Actual authentic trial/unit/prediction counts are unknown.
data_contract.source_fidelity: Preserve source dropna across all original columns, literal None handling, source event/trial ordering and unit census. Source40-bin rates divide counts by2; do not silently replace with a Hz convention. Offline Gaussian window16/std4/edge renormalization and per-unit/per-trial sample-SD normalization remain source operations pending native parity.
data_contract.unit_support: Every source unit and raw row accounted for, including empty event support; all-unit-zero-event trials hard-refuse pending explicit adjudication. No silent cell, trial, context, fold, session or mouse deletion.

source_revision_limit: Selected Figure6f numerical source is consistent across these observations, but byte identity is reported exactly and no whole-repository commit equivalence or runtime parity is claimed.
